details: px is fixed. rem is relative to the root font size (16px by default), so it respects the reader’s browser setting. em is relative to the parent, which compounds when nested. clamp() gives a size that grows with the viewport between a minimum and a maximum.

values.note: 0.875 × the parent’s size; compounds in nested elements.
Fluid: 4% of the viewport width, kept between 24px and 40px.
A keyword, one step smaller than medium.

gotcha: em sizes multiply: a 0.8em list inside a 0.8em list is 0.64 of the original. Use rem when you want a size that does not depend on nesting.
